description.en: Thousands of years ago, a catastrophe struck the land. The culprit was Shen Nan Chen, the beloved disciple of the Spiritual Father Gu Bei Mu. He led all the demonic beasts in the land with the ancient divine relic "Yuze's Record of Mountains and Seas" and started a war in the three worlds. The master, Gu Bei Mu, killed Shen Nan Chen with his own hands with a motionless Sword. Thousands of years later, Shen Nan Chen reincarnated as a college student, enters the Hall of Spiritual cultivation and searches for the truth about his demonic past.

description.en:
In the world of Yin and Yang, the Wu family has upheld its traditions for three generations. Wu FengXian, an extraordinary young man with a peculiar destiny and seemingly inept magical abilities but outstanding combat skills, is the sole heir to the Wu family legacy and the designated servant of the deity chosen by the fox spirit guarding their home. Unfortunately, his unique destiny attracts unwanted attention, leading him to leave the rural area where strange phenomena frequently occur. However, urban legends and supernatural tales continue to follow Wu FengXian.

Despite his passionate spirit, Wu FengXian faces repeated setbacks due to his limited strength. Faced with the choice between exerting effort and taking it easy, he relies on his personal charm to opt for the latter. Wu FengXian, with a burning sense of justice, strives to save and protect the land passed down through generations, preventing the infiltration of the dark forces from Fengdu. Additionally, he seeks to cultivate a romantic relationship with his beloved sister. Wu FengXian confronts the challenges posed by his unique and deficient destiny, eventually defying fate, combating demons, and awakening the deity to fulfill his mission.
description.zh: 阴阳世家三代吴奉天，是个命格奇葩、法术废材但嘴欠实力满分的少年。哪怕吊儿郎当也是吴家衣钵唯一继承人、镇宅狐仙指定的侍奉神君，可惜命格吸引酆都作祟，他迫不得已离开异象频发的乡野，却又被都市怪谈缠身。吴奉天有热血道心，但实力不济屡遭打脸，在选择努力还是躺平的问题上，凭借个人魅力“躺赢”才是吴奉天的最佳选择。为拯救并守护祖辈生长的土地、维持人间世界不被酆都暗流侵扰、更是为了能和心爱的妹子修成正果，吴奉天与五弊三缺的孤寡命格抗争，终归逆天改命、降妖除魔、神君觉醒。
